The rock is solid and immovable. Let me reconsider whether the map legend might be misleading — maybe the rock at (11,4) doesn't actually block the (11,3) gap if I approach from a diagonal. But movement is 4-directional, so no.

Let me try the NoClip cheat — the controls list it as a cheat modifier "only while a cheat switch is on." Let me check if there's a way to enable it. Actually, let me first try walking to the chest tile directly one more time in case the pathfinder now finds a route.
